## Context / Problem
Test assets outside `tests/unit/`, including interface, script, integration, external, and end-to-end suites contain confirmed comment or docstring bloat from the audit pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`. File-specific constraints must survive consolidation.

## Approach
Delegate remediation to bounded directory/subsystem leaf cohorts. Each leaf edits only its declared paths, preserves the requirements recorded in its Scope, and supplies the authoritative file-impact set. Responsibilities remain non-overlapping, and each change stays reviewable in one session.

## Scope
- Direct container edits: none; repository edits belong to the leaf cohorts.
- Delegated repository area: Test assets outside `tests/unit/`, including interface, script, integration, external, and end-to-end suites.
- Audited-path boundary: paths carried by the file impacts of the retired source tickets reached through each leaf net-active `supersedes` links. Repository paths outside that source set were not selected by the audit and are outside this workstream.

## Migration inventory
At story completion, the epic driver produces the inventory from live tracker state returned by `rebar list --parent written-peerless-kusimanse --full --output json` plus each leaf net-active `supersedes` targets. The driver follows each target and compares its file impact with the replacement leaf Scope rows and file impact.

The durable inventory is a sorted TSV entry in a dedicated `session_log` linked `relates_to` this story. Each row is `path<TAB>replacement-leaf-alias<TAB>source-ticket-alias<TAB>scope-count<TAB>file-impact-count`. The story completion comment cites that session-log id and records row count plus SHA-256 of the TSV. Passing requires one row per audited source path, one replacement leaf per source ticket, `scope-count=1`, `file-impact-count=1`, no extra replacement paths, and equal expected/Scope/file-impact path sets.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every audited source path has exactly one inventory row; verified by the story-linked TSV session log.
- [ ] Every inventory row names exactly one replacement leaf Scope; verified by `scope-count=1`.
- [ ] Every inventory row names exactly one matching replacement file-impact record; verified by `file-impact-count=1`.
- [ ] Each path retains every current constraint listed by its leaf Scope; verified by the leaf row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] Each path retains its listed consumer contract; verified by the leaf row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] Redundant or historical prose identified by the leaf Scope is removed; verified by the leaf row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] Each leaf verification command exits 0 before that leaf closes.

## Child decomposition
Each directory/subsystem cohort owns all criteria for its exact path set. Cohort path sets are disjoint; their union is this workstream audited-path boundary.
